note: Held tier-5 English Wikipedia compilation for the PT-91 Twardy. The registry marks primary_held false because the article is a secondary compilation. It publishes the mass, the length with the barrel forward, the width, the height, the ground clearance, the engine model, the engine rating of 850 hp with no net basis, the manual transmission, the maximum road speed and the range. It publishes no track shoe width, no track pitch and no grouser statement, so the entry is not runtime-ready.
